summary: Wide layouts painted two page tones (a surface backdrop behind background-toned screens and space bodies) and left limited-measure columns (menus, settings, forms, profile, content, game menus, history, explorer) pinned to the left of the frame with their titles out of line; the frame now paints one background canvas, the frame column is centered, and every capped column keeps that column's leading edge with its title block in the same column.
